messages:
samira: Customer reported AWS invoice shows two separate line items for the same metered usage window, effectively doubling billed amount vs our dashboard.

maria: Can you paste invoice IDs and a screenshot of line items?

samira: Invoice: INV-2026-07-3421, line items: LI-987654 and LI-987655. Screenshot attached. Customer says our dashboard shows single-day usage 12,300 tokens, but AWS shows 2×12,300 under two adjacent line items.

maria: thanks. assigning to billing to validate how we generate MP reports. @lee can you pull the raw metering events for that customer and date?

lee: pulling now. give me a min.

billing-bot: [automated] Marketplace metering report queued for export: job_id=mp-export-20260715-77

josh: tagging eng-runtime in case it's an export window bug. @maria any chance the customer is in a timezone where midnight cut overlaps?

maria: customer timezone = America/Los_Angeles. invoice dates are in UTC. could be rollover.

lee: raw metering events show duplicate submits for the same entitlement id at 2026-07-14T23:58:30Z and 2026-07-15T00:00:05Z. two submissions ~35s apart for identical token counts.

samira: customer insists they only made one request batch. can we see request ids tied to those metering events?

lee: checking.

lee: found XRQ ids: xrq_01A and xrq_01B. Same session, different submit timestamps. both were included in the marketplace usage export. Looks like our batch flusher retried and caused duplicate meter records.

josh: that points to a retry/ack path where the gateway didn't mark the metering as "acknowledged" before responding. If the exporter later re-runs, it picks both.

maria: any logs for gateway around 23:58:30Z? can eng share?

josh: yes. log snippet:
```
2026-07-14T23:58:30Z gateway: meter_submit id=xrq_01A -> response 200
2026-07-14T23:58:32Z gateway: meter_ack failed id=xrq_01A err=timeout
2026-07-15T00:00:05Z gateway: meter_submit id=xrq_01B -> response 200
```

josh: gateway returned 200 for submit but the ack path had a transient timeout, so the submission flow retried from client side and generated a second submit record.

lee: exporter dedupe currently only uses (entitlement_id, date). since the two events landed in adjacent dates (UTC boundary) dedupe missed them. hence two line items.

maria: ok — root cause: combination of client retry + ack timeout + exporter dedupe being date-bound across UTC boundary.

samira: customer wants immediate relief, they were double-billed. suggestion?

lee: we can issue a credit for the duplicated line item now. finance approval required.

lee: @lee -> raising ledger credit ticket: TKT-CC-4477. waiting sign-off.

lee: finance (lee) approved temporary credit for INV-2026-07-3421 line item LI-987655 amount $1,430. credit issued.

maria: noted. customer notified and invoice updated.

josh: short-term mitigation: update exporter dedupe to use (entitlement_id, usage_window_start_timestamp, usage_hash) rather than date bucket, and treat submissions within a 5-minute tolerance as duplicates.

josh: long-term: fix gateway ack path to avoid client-side duplicate submits (more reliable ack persistence) and add idempotency token on meter submit.

maria: timeline?

josh: quick fix to exporter dedupe deployable in ~48 hrs (config-only change), ack-path fix will take ~2 weeks with tests.

maria: I'll keep customer updated. adding follow-up tasks: (1) credit issued (done), (2) exporter dedupe config change (in progress), (3) gateway ack reliability ticket (eng backlog).

samira: customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick credit and the plan. Will wait for change to avoid future surprises."

maria: closing loop. we should also add a monitoring alert for high ratio of marketplace line-items per invoice vs dashboard expected.

lee: added alert MP_DUPLICATE_RATE to SLO dashboard, threshold 0.2.

josh: PR for dedupe change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/mp-export/pull/256

maria: marking thread resolved. will reopen if customer sees new issue. :white_check_mark:
